$comment: Contract for the AddSection server-side command (AD-003, AD-123). Questions arrive as a JSON array in a string parameter, because Custom API parameters are scalars. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_AddSection
customApi.description: Creates a section under the checklist version in force, with its questions, in one transaction. Owned by Tax, AQS or Both. Enforces Edit on question.retire and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: SectionCode
requestParameters.description: Unique code for the section, for example S-CD2.

requestParameters.name: Name
requestParameters.description: Section name as the reviewer reads it.

requestParameters.name: HelpText
requestParameters.description: Optional guidance shown under the heading.

requestParameters.name: OwnerRole
requestParameters.description: 120910100 Tax team, 120910101 AQS checker, or 120910105 Both.

requestParameters.name: DisplayOrder
requestParameters.description: Optional integer. Absent appends after the highest in the version.

requestParameters.name: IsOptional
requestParameters.description: 'true' or 'false'. Absent is false. An optional section's questions are not owed at submit.

requestParameters.name: EffectiveFrom
requestParameters.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd. Absent is today. May not be in the past.

requestParameters.name: Questions
requestParameters.description: Optional JSON array of {code, name, wording, responseType, mandatory, displayOrder}. Must be an array, not an object.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same section.

responseProperties.name: QuestionIds
responseProperties.description: Comma-separated ids of the questions created, in order.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
